body:
Attempting to make Xanax Lean
Dose 2 mg alprazolam
T- 0:05 at 9:30pm crushed up 2 mg worth of xanax and put it in a double cup of baja blast
T+ 0:00 start mixing by pouring one of the full cups into one of the empty cups 3x times and start drinking it overall tasted like baja blast with a slight unpleasant taste of the crushed xanax
T+ 0:10 about ⅓ done with the drink starting to feel not really noticeably but slightly tired
T+ 0:23 so im a little past ½ done now there is a stronger unpleasant taste not too bad tho
T+ 0:30 finished the rest of the drink and noticing its harder to think about what exactly i'm doing and sometimes im doing things more incorrectly like typing this right now also feeling slight fun sensations in my fingers as they move from key to key
T+ 0:33 If I focus on nothing else except feeling in my body I notice a bit of mild euphoria or body sensations also feeling really relaxed and in a couched locked like state like weed causes also once the ice melts i'm gonna drink it to get any excess xanax I may have missed
T+ 0:50 loss in coordination as I expected to happen but even when standing still I get wobbly and tipsy when pulling up my computer to type this I looked down at the keys and my vision seemed to have a lagging effect but very so slightly
T+ 0:56 feelings of mild euphoria strangely only in my lower calf and upper ankle area
T- 1:01 Huge notice of motor control loss also tried to listen to music but any song just sounds mid even ones I really like so i'd say some form of decreased music appreciation as I tried to listen to my favorite artist and I didn't really like a song in that moment
T+ 1:03 for the past 15 minutes have thought about taking 2 mg more to try to achieve a sense of physical euphoria but deciding not too
T+ 1:06 noticing I have to take deeper breaths when inhaling as taking normal breathes feels as if im unaware im getting any oxygen
T+ 1:15 came into my dark room and on the tv remote which has a glowing light on it I seen a spider on it that wasn't really there for 2-3 seconds like deliriant type effect and xanax was the only thing that was taken so I thought that was really weird but kinda cool
T- 1:32 sitting on couch and feeling a bit more sensations throughout my body and just now realizing that my short term memory is fucked up as when I go to do a task Ill continue to do it even though I forgot whatever the fuck it is im doing
T- 1:39 feeling calm my muscles are really relaxed maybe I'm actually starting to get a very mild, light sense of euphoria weeds euphoria is definitely way better though also realizing why xanax sucks and is kinda one of the worst recreational drugs out there as I dont have the motivation to do anything now and even when I'm doing something it's often done incorrectly and the effects are just being tired in a decently good way
As the effects of xanax make me not want to do anything I stopped the report there but I remember I made my room completely dark and layed in my bed to try to make the most of the relaxing sedative effects and ended up falling asleep and I woke up at about 9 am feeling really relaxed and my coordination was a bit poor for like 2 hours.
